prompt: A photograph of a sculpture carved from compacted damp sand on a beach, photographed as a real object. The sculpture is a dragon coiled twice around a carved column, its head at the top, individual scales cut with a knife point down the length of its back. The whole form is one colour of wet sand, tool marks from a flat trowel run across the broad planes, fine dry sand has crumbled away from the undercuts and lies in little cones at the base, individual grains catch the light along every edge, and one thin detail has already collapsed. Shot on a 50mm at f8 in low raking evening sunlight from the left that makes the grain texture read across the whole surface, wet sand and sky behind, natural colour.
medium_blurb: Compacted damp sand, carved and crumbling.
